source: NASA JPL Horizons API observer table: CENTER='coord@301', COORD_TYPE='GEODETIC', QUANTITIES='4,20' (apparent az/el, airless)

conventions.azimuth_deg: degrees clockwise from local lunar north, [0, 360)
conventions.elevation_deg: degrees above the local horizontal, airless (no refraction), no terrain
conventions.altitude_km: height above the 1737.4 km IAU mean sphere (site elevation + observer height)
conventions.time: UTC, ISO-8601 with Z; both bodies share one timestamp
